subject: Bugs in Distance: Bugzilla is now online

messages.author: 39f0839e8d6a4470
messages.subject: Bugs in Distance: Bugzilla is now online
parts:
Dear All,

There is now an online bugzilla database for Distance. This allows you to=
search for bugs which have been reported and check to see if there has b=
een any progress made on them or if there are suggested workarounds. If y=
ou discover new bugs which are not in the database there is a facility to=
add them.

In addition to bug reporting, bugzilla provides an option to suggest any =
enhancements you would like to see in the software. To suggest an enhance=
ment proceed as if you were reporting a bug but choose "enhancement" wher=
e you are asked for the severity of the bug.

A link to the bugzilla database for Distance can be found at:

http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/bugreport.html


Laura Marshall
